newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil October exports hit by computer breakdown.
newsitem.headline: Brazil October exports hit by computer breakdown.

text.p: Brazil's official exports in the month of October will be missing about six hours worth of shipments because of a computer breakdown, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
October exports were due to be announced at 1300 local time/1500 GMT Tuesday.
The spokeswoman said the computer system recording exports crashed in the afternoon of October 31 and all export data from midday to about 1830 local time was lost.

In a statement, the government agency running the data-collecitng system, SERPRO, said exports for those six hours would have to be collated manually and that would take a few days. They would therefore not be included in the official export figure for the month.

Concern over Brazil's worsening trade balance has spread through the markets. On Monday, Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said October's trade deficit would not exceed the $655 million gap posted in September.
